en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal in an old European city. On the left stand tall brick gabled buildings and a church spire; a narrow street curves alongside the canal, where a horse‑drawn cart and pedestrians are visible. On the right are more traditional townhouses and a straight quay. A small bridge and dense vegetation cross and border the canal in the mid‑distance. Printed caption text in French appears at the top, identifying the location in Bruges and the specific quay and street.
